alert.title: Critical: Suspected Account Compromise - Post-Authentication Anomalous Activity
alert.description: Following the impossible-travel login flagged in case eval-suspicious-login-triage, user r.alvarez's session performed anomalous actions: a new MFA device was registered, a bulk download occurred from the finance SharePoint site, and an access attempt was made to the payroll admin console - all inconsistent with the user's normal behavior baseline.
